title: tc-model-picker
description: The model menu of an AI chat: models with strength bars, extended thinking with its effort, and web search.

models.description: The models to choose from, in menu order – each with its strengths, first-token time and price

value.description: Id of the chosen model – unset or unknown shows the first

effort.description: How hard the model thinks – only shown while extended thinking is on

align.description: Which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with

side.description: Whether the menu opens below or above the trigger – above suits a composer at the bottom of the screen

description.description: One short line under the name, e.g. "Hardest problems"

speed.description: Strengths from 1 to 5. Cost 5 is the most expensive. Leave all three out for a router like "Auto"

latencyMs.description: Typical time to the first token without extended thinking, in milliseconds

pricePerM.description: Price per million output tokens, in dollars
